gpt.rationale: Nonpayment of rent is a statutory ground for removal under § 2A:18-61.1(a). Section 2A:18-61.2 expressly states that no notice is required for an eviction based on nonpayment of rent under § 2A:18-61.1(a).

gemini.rationale: New Jersey's Anti-Eviction Act requires a written Notice to Quit for most causes for eviction. The statute does not list nonpayment of rent as a cause requiring such a notice before the landlord files an eviction complaint.

pay_or_quit.description: Nonpayment of rent — NJ has no statutory notice period for nonpayment. N.J.S.A. §2A:18-61.2 expressly carves nonpayment out of the notice-to-quit requirement; a covered landlord may file the summary dispossess action immediately. Exception: federally subsidized housing requires 14 days. Separately, habitual late payment (after a notice to cease) carries a one-month notice under §2A:18-61.2(b) — that is a different ground, not the nonpayment period. Attorney confirmed: Andrew Cohen, 2026-06-16.

exceptions.authority: federal subsidy program rules; cf. N.J.S.A. §2A:18-61.2 carve-out

tenancy_all.statute: N.J.S.A. §2A:18-61.1 (nonpayment ground); N.J.S.A. §2A:18-61.2 (nonpayment excluded from notice-to-quit requirement — immediate filing permitted for market-rate tenancy)

federal.name: SCRA § 3951 (Servicemembers Civil Relief Act)
federal.applies_when: Servicemembers and their dependents occupying a residence as their primary dwelling, where the servicemember's military service materially affects their ability to pay the rent.
federal.effect: During a period of military service, a landlord may not evict a servicemember or their dependents from their primary residence without first obtaining a court order. Court may stay proceedings up to 90 days or adjust the rental obligation. Protection applies when monthly rent does not exceed the annual threshold: $4,954.34/month (2024; formula: 130% of BAH for E-5 with dependents, highest BAH area — adjusted annually by DoD). Landlord must file affidavit of non-military-service before default judgment may enter (50 U.S.C. § 3931(b)(1)). FY23 NDAA amendment: replaced CPI-adjusted fixed-dollar threshold with current BAH formula.
federal.statute: 50 U.S.C. § 3951; as amended by Pub. L. 117-263, Div. E, Title LV, § 555 (FY23 NDAA, Dec. 23, 2022)
